name: speedometer
description: A pane with a context-window speedometer, an activity badge, rate limits, cost, model and turn stats

theme.title: Gauge cluster
theme.description: The look of the pane. classic: three plain dials. minimal: no gauges, only context, cost, model, turns and agents. Plain styles: bars, rings, battery, digital, columns. Vehicle dashboards: eighties-digital-dash, white-face-muscle, hexagon-tft, five-dial-sports, spartan-supercar, neon-grid, race-wheel, tuner-mfd, scanner-dash, fifties-chrome, chrono-console, nineties-rally. Beyond the road: vu-meter, weather-station, steampunk, hourglass, retro-arcade.

wallClock.title: Count every hour
wallClock.description: Project burn rate over every hour of every day. Off: only the work day set below, Monday to Friday unless Count weekends is on.

workStart.title: Work day starts
workStart.description: Used only when Count every hour is off: projections count time from this to the end of the work day, as HH:MM local. Equal start and end counts every hour.

workEnd.title: Work day ends
workEnd.description: Used only when Count every hour is off. HH:MM local.

weekends.title: Count weekends
weekends.description: Used only when Count every hour is off: count Saturday and Sunday in projections. Off: Monday to Friday only.
